parts.text: How did last night's backup go?

messages.text: How did last night's backup go?

parts.text:
The **nightly backup** finished. <Badge tone="success">3 of 3 copied</Badge>

- Photos took `14 min`, twice as long as last week.
- Documents and mail were quick.

| Folder | Time |
| --- | --- |
| Photos | 14 min |
| Mail | 2 min |

```
folder	minutes
photos	14
```

The full log is in [the backup report](https://example.com/backups/nightly).
